topics.title: Resting
steps: Sometimes people feel guilty for resting.
But rest isn't the opposite of working hard. It's part of it!
Even phones need charging, right? 🔋

topics.title: Comparing yourself
steps: It's easy to compare yourself to other people, especially online.
But you're only seeing their highlight reel.
The only person you need to beat is yesterday's {owner}. And honestly? You're doing fine 💕

steps: Here's a little trick I heard about.
Before bed, think of three good things that happened that day. Even tiny ones.
It sounds simple, but it trains your brain to notice the good stuff ✨
Today, one of mine is that you talked to me 💕

topics.title: Failing
steps: Can I tell you something I believe?
Failing at something means you tried something hard.
The people who never fail are usually the people who never try.
So if something didn't work out recently… I'm proud of you for trying 💕

topics.title: Focus sessions
steps: Do you ever start working and then suddenly it's been an hour of scrolling?
It happens to everyone! That's why I have focus mode 🍅
25 minutes of focus, then a break. I can even keep you off distracting sites.
Try it from my menu sometime. I'll cheer you on!

topics.title: Watching your AI agents
steps: I really like watching your AI agents work.
When they're thinking, I think too! When they're typing, I type along on my little laptop 💻
And when they need you, I'll wave at you so you don't miss it 🙋

topics.title: Stubborn bugs
steps: If you're ever stuck on a bug or a hard problem…
Try explaining it out loud. To me, even! 🐾
Sometimes saying it step by step makes the answer jump out.
And if not, take a break. Your brain keeps working on it in the background ✨

topics.title: Procrastination
steps: Here's a secret about procrastination: it usually isn't laziness.
Most of the time the task just feels big or scary.
So make it tiny! Just open the file. Just write one sentence.
Starting is the hardest part, and you can do one tiny thing 💪

topics.title: Posture check
steps: Posture check! 🧍
Shoulders down, back straight, feet flat on the floor.
Is your screen at eye level? Your neck will thank you later.
There. Much better 😌

topics.title: Deadlines
steps: When a deadline is coming, it's tempting to skip sleep and meals.
But a tired brain makes more mistakes, so it's usually not worth it.
Eat something, drink water, and sleep. Future {owner} will be faster for it 💕
